module: Tutorial scene setup: prefabs, sites (parking zones), tutorial vehicle (sunburst2, config apmTutorial_sunburst), placing the player on foot, blocking input actions, and "out of bounds" reset with screen fade. Used by gameplay_tutorial_runtime and by the steps; it only keeps the vehicle id, not the object.
notes: The loaded sites file is /gameplay/tutorials/tutorialZones.sites.json; the points used are tutorialCarStart, playerWalkingStart, dragPlayerStart and dragCarStart.
Prefabs are loaded from gameplay/tutorials/<id>.prefab.json and named <id>Prefab.
The out-of-bounds reset goes through ui_fadeScreen: the callback is executed when onScreenFadeState receives state 2.
The tutorial vehicle is frozen (setFreeze), gearbox in realistic mode, ignition off on spawn.
Gearboxes are blocked by default (blockedActions); unblockGearActions() releases them.
The out-of-zone warning message is hardcoded in English and does not go through the translation system.

tutorialVehicleId.desc: Tutorial vehicle id (nil before spawn and after cleanup). Steps use getObjectByID on it.

vehicleSetupComplete.desc: true when the vehicle is ready and the player placed (end of setupPlayer).

tutorialSites.desc: Loaded sites (parkingSpots, etc.); nil until loadTutorialSites has succeeded.

blockedActions.desc: Individually blocked input actions (gear1..8, gearN, gearR, shiftUp, shiftDown, setShifterMode: all true by default).

blockedActionsTemplates.desc: Action groups (aiControls, bigMap, freeCam, resetPhysics, walkingMode, vehicleSwitching...) blocked when the value is true.

setOutOfBoundsResetAllowed.desc: Allows or not the out-of-bounds reset (to allow once the welcome pop-ups are closed).

isOutOfBoundsResetAllowed.desc: Indicates whether the out-of-bounds reset is allowed.

setOutOfBoundsResetHandler.desc: Sets the reset callback specific to the current step (otherwise placePlayerBackToParkingStart is used).

activateOutOfBoundsSystem.desc: Enables the zone bounds system (outOfBoundsSystemActive = true).

spawnPrefab.desc: Spawns a prefab in MissionGroup (canSave = false) and stores it for cleanup.

setActivePrefabs.desc: Enables or disables prefabs of gameplay/tutorials/ according to an id -> boolean table; only touches those whose state changes. Reloads collision if something changed.

cleanup.desc: Resets everything: flags, reset handlers, created prefabs (deleted, collision reloaded) and tutorialVehicleId.

loadTutorialSites.desc: Loads the tutorial sites file via gameplay_sites_sitesManager.loadSites and stores it in tutorialSites.

setupVehicles.desc: Resets the setup flags to false, then spawns the tutorial vehicle and calls setupPlayer once ready.

onLoadingScreenFadeout.desc: Hook called at the end of the loading screen fade; sets loadingScreenFadeoutComplete to true.

setupPlayer.desc: Puts the player in walking mode at the playerWalkingStart position (or a hardcoded default position) then places them back at the start point; sets vehicleSetupComplete to true.

spawnTutorialVehicle.desc: Spawns the tutorial's sunburst2 at the tutorialCarStart site (without entering it), stores its id, sets the gearbox to realistic, freezes the vehicle and turns the ignition off, then calls thenFunction.

thenFunction.desc: Called when the vehicle has responded to the mainController/gearboxMode request.

returns.desc: Vehicle object, nil if spawning failed.

unblockGearActions.desc: Sets all gear actions of blockedActions to false and reapplies the filter.

placePlayerBackToParkingStart.desc: Teleports the player: on foot, to the playerWalkingStart site; in a vehicle, the tutorial vehicle to tutorialCarStart, and puts the player in it if they are not in it.

runOutOfBoundsResetWithFade.desc: Starts a 0.3 s screen fade; the callback will be executed at fade state 2. Ignored if a reset is already pending.

runCurrentStepOutOfBoundsReset.desc: Starts the out-of-bounds reset with the current step's handler, otherwise with the placement at the start point.

showOutOfBoundsWarning.desc: Displays for 3 s a message task "Please stay inside of the evaluation zone." in the UI task list (SetTasklistTask then DiscardTasklistItem).

onScreenFadeState.desc: Hook called on screen fade state changes; at state 2 and if a reset is pending, runs the callback, stops the fade and displays the warning.

state.desc: Fade state (2 = screen fully blackened, inferred from code).

placePlayerAtDragStart.desc: Puts the player on foot and teleports them to the dragPlayerStart site (or 6 m behind dragCarStart), facing forward.

placePlayerBackInTutorialVehicle.desc: Puts the player back in the tutorial vehicle if they are walking or driving something else.

setupBlockedActions.desc: Builds the blocked actions list (group templates set to true + individual actions set to true) and registers it as the tutorialBlockedActions group of player 0's action filter.
